note: Both sets correctly capture the reference keynotes and the west-elevation dimensions (TOP OF STEEL 11'-5", INT. STEP 2'-6 1/8"), but A additionally binds the sheet number P-401 and the SOLAR PUMP STATION keynote (23 56 01), which B omits. B invents a dimension "STEP 1 1/8"" that appears nowhere on the page (the only step dimension is INT. STEP 2'-6 1/8") and misbinds C1's title to "MECHANICAL", when C1 is titled MECHANICAL ROOM LAYOUT and "MECHANICAL" is only part of the sheet title. Both sets pad with unsupported "connection | system/component" claims whose quotes are bare keynote tags, and both call the A1/A3/A5 elevation callouts "section reference" (B three times, A once). A keeps the MECH ROOM WEST ELEVATION condition on the step dimension and makes no fabricated or misbound value, so it is the more faithful set despite its vague filler.
